DeHub is a censorship resistant, open source alternative to legacy media platforms servicing the content creation, streaming and gaming industries. An ecosystem where anyone can monetise from the first view, without fear of being deplatformed, shadow banned, silenced or manipulated in anyway to be anything but their true self. To speak and think free, away from the hive mind, express as desired.

The app is scaled via a decentralized miner network, providing shared computing power to host, transcode, and deliver content that by design, should live forever.

As the first protocol to tokenise content back in 2023, we've built a sustainable socialfi solution that empowers creators and consumers with a plethora of tools. Features include encrypted private communications, on-chain PPV releases, tradable subscriptions, paid DMs, unlockable content, shared ad revenue and many more these docs cover in full.

Sign up with Google, Apple, Telegram, email, SMS or a passkey and a wallet is generated for you in a few clicks. No private key management or custody: you are in full control of your assets and we never access your funds.

Given that data is the new oil, it may be wise to build your core community base here and utilise your existing social media apps to funnel users in to grow your own valuable database and ensure you remain censorship resistant. No matter what happens, never lose touch with your audience, fans, community or customers.

Accounts & Signing In

There are several ways into DeHub and none of them require you to already own a wallet. Sign in with Google, Apple or Telegram, with a code sent to your email address or by SMS, with a passkey on your phone or computer, or by connecting a wallet you already use. Everything except the wallet route generates a non-custodial wallet for you in the background: you hold the keys, we never take custody, and gas is sponsored so you can post, tip and collect without ever buying a native token. You are only asked to protect that wallet the first time you actually use it, not while signing up.

One person can run several identities from the same browser. Profiles are managed in Settings → Profile: add an account, switch between them, and DeHub swaps the whole session — wallet, feed, messages and notifications — in one step. Adding a profile never signs you out of the one you are on, and a switch that cannot be completed rolls back to where you were. How many profiles you can park in the list scales with your staking badge.

  • Social sign-in: Google, Apple or Telegram, one tap, wallet created for you and gas sponsored from the first post.
  • Email or SMS: Enter an address or a phone number and confirm the code that arrives. The same two routes migrate a legacy DeHub account onto the new stack.
  • Existing wallet: Connect MetaMask, Rainbow, Trust, Phantom or anything WalletConnect speaks to, and sign once to prove the address. If a Phantom sign-in is refused because its Ethereum address has no history, you can prove your Solana wallet instead. Wallet users pay their own gas.
  • Multiple profiles: Keep several accounts side by side in Settings → Profile and switch without logging out and back in. Your badge tier decides how many you can hold.
  • New members: Everyone who joins lands in the New Members directory and carries a new-member chip next to their name for their first thirty days, so the community can spot and welcome them. New members are also offered an optional guided walkthrough, which can be reopened later from Settings.
  • Passkey: Choose "Continue with fingerprint" and the passkey itself is the account — no email, no phone number, no password. The same passkey works on the website and in the Android app.
  • Import or migrate: The sign-in sheet has separate options to import the keys of a wallet you already hold and to migrate an earlier DeHub account, so new sign-ups never have to choose between them.
  • Leaving: You can delete your account yourself from Settings. Your profile, uploads and stored media, including backup copies, are erased, and a Sign in with Apple link is revoked. Anything already written to a public blockchain stays there.

Feeds & Content Formats

The DeHub home surface is a single tabbed feed that carries every content format at once. Instead of forcing creators into one medium, the feed blends text, images, long-form video, short-form reels, music and live streams into one scroll, and lets viewers narrow to a single format whenever they want. Every card, regardless of format, carries the same social and monetisation controls: like, comment, repost, quote, bookmark and tip in DeHub tokens.

Formats are surfaced as tabs across the top of the feed. The default Home tab interleaves everything from the people and communities you follow; the dedicated tabs isolate one medium so you can, for example, browse only long-form video or only music. Ranking is driven by the platform leaderboard algorithm documented further down this page, so quality and engagement, not ad spend, decide reach.

Key Features

  • Home Feed: A mixed feed of text, image, article, video, audio and live posts. Likes, comments, reposts, quotes, bookmarks and token tipping are built into every card, and posts can be gated, made pay-per-view or set to watch2earn. So that nobody can flood it, the home feed carries a limited number of each author's posts per day: one without a badge and one more for every badge tier, up to fourteen at Megalodon. Everything still appears on the author's profile and in the Following sort.
  • Sorting & filtering: Latest comes first in the sort tabs, followed by the engagement sorts, including Most Tips. Tapping a hashtag filters the feed to it, videos you have already watched can be marked and hidden, and any live stages sit at the top of Home.
  • Shorts: A vertical, swipeable short-video reel for TikTok-style viewing. Direction-locked swipe gestures move between clips, momentum is capped so you never skip two at once, and monetisation applies to every clip.
  • Polls: Create poll posts and collect votes inline in the feed. Results update live and can be used to drive community decisions or governance sentiment.
  • Dedicated Tabs: Switch between Videos, Images, Music and Live tabs to browse a single format at a time, each with its own layout tuned to that medium.
  • Bookmarks & Leaderboard: Save any post to your private bookmarks for later, and track the top creators on the platform leaderboard, ranked by the algorithm described below.
  • Reactions: Ten reactions sit behind the like button: like, love, respect, hot, 100, lol, sad, cry, poo and dislike. Every one except dislike counts towards the post's like total. Double-tap a post to like it, triple-tap to love it, and hold the button to open the tray, which shows who reacted and with what. The leading icon on a card is whichever reaction the post drew most. A reaction is weighted by the reactor's badge, so who reacted matters as well as how many did. Left-handed mode in Settings moves the like button to the left of the bar.
  • Comments & Threads: Every post carries comments with their own likes, dislikes and view counts. Tap a comment to reply to it. When an author replies to themselves the run becomes a numbered thread. A creator can pin one comment on their own post; the thread then leads with that pin, then a paid Comment Anchor, then the five most-tipped comments. Creators can turn on Common Ground mode for a post, which asks readers for the other side's strongest point before their first reply, and the AI button in the comment box checks your tone, changes its style or fixes spelling and grammar. Any comment can be reported from its share menu.
  • Mature Content: Creators mark a post as mature while composing it. Mature posts stay off the public home feed and out of search, but remain fully visible on the creator's profile and to anyone following them. Viewers who want them everywhere turn on "Show mature content" in settings.
  • Mute & Block: Mute or block an author from the ⋯ menu on any post. Muting drops them out of your feed quietly and can be undone; blocking goes further, works both ways and cuts messaging too.
  • Automatic Translation: Posts and comments translate into your language as you scroll, in over a hundred languages, with no wallet connection and no setting to find. Tap through to the original at any time.
  • Video dubbing: Hear a video in your own language: choose Dub from the subtitles menu or the video's options, and your device reads the translated transcript aloud. It is free and runs on your device.

Upload

On the above user upload dashboard, notice how simple it is for anyone to instantly upload content and in a few clicks enable the following:

  • Watch2earn: every token now has sustainable watch2earn utility at the click of a button
  • Token gated content: stream or upload content locked behind any token contract viewers must hold
  • PPV events: charge any token for a pay-per-view or live stream
  • NFT collectables: mint a post as an NFT and it carries the lifetime royalty attached to the video. Minting is optional — a post publishes instantly off-chain, with no wallet and no signature, and can be minted later from the post itself
  • Earn: DeHub tokens via tips through supporters and rise up on the leaderboards for larger shares of ad revenue
  • Subscribers: Upload or stream content exclusively for your subscribers
  • Galleries: A post can carry several images rather than one: four without a badge, rising with each badge tier to twenty at Megalodon, and each image can be up to 42.069 MB. Drag the images into the order you want before posting, draw or write on them in the composer, and open any photo fullscreen to see the original file at full resolution, pinch and zoom.
  • Audio posts: Music and spoken audio post like any other format, with a visualiser on the card and a corner player that keeps playing while you carry on scrolling the feed.
  • Composer tools: Paste images or video straight into the composer, save the whole post as a draft, schedule it for later (scheduled posts show on your profile), mark it "Made for kids" or mature, and send it to your other social accounts in the same step. A video's cover can be changed afterwards from Edit Post.

Articles

Long-form writing has its own mode. Switch the composer from Post to Article and you get a title, a body of up to 20,000 characters, a formatting toolbar, a cover image and a preview of how it will read. An article publishes like any other post, so it can be tipped, quoted, gated and shared, and it gets its own share card when the link is posted elsewhere.

  • Write and format: Headings, emphasis, lists and links from the toolbar, with a preview before you publish.
  • Images: Add a cover image that leads the article and appears on its card in the feed.
  • Drafts: Save an unfinished article as a draft — title, body and image together — and come back to it later.

Post Everywhere at Once

Publish on DeHub and on your other social accounts in the same step. Connect the accounts once in Settings → Multi-post, then pick where each post goes from the cross-post icon in the composer. DeHub stays the home of the post; the copies carry it to the audiences you already have elsewhere.

  • Thirteen platforms: X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Google Business, Snapchat, Discord and Farcaster. Farcaster posts go through a signer you approve in the Farcaster app.
  • Post credits: Each delivery spends credits per platform, priced at roughly what that platform costs to reach. Credits are bought with DeHub tokens, with a discount on larger bundles, and anything you are short of is bought when you post.
  • Scheduling: A scheduled post goes out to your other accounts when it publishes; its credits are spent when you schedule it.

Daily posting allowance

Posting on DeHub is free every day, up to an allowance that scales with your staking badge. Everybody starts with ten text posts and one gigabyte of video, images and audio per day. Go past either one and the rest of that day is paid for in DeHub tokens — 10c a text post, $2 a gigabyte, charged only on the part that runs over.

Text posts and media are separate pools. Running out of one does not touch the other, so a day spent uploading video still leaves all ten text posts free. Both reset at midnight UTC.

How paying works

The order matters, and it is deliberate: you are never charged for a post that did not publish, and you never upload a large file only to be told afterwards that you cannot pay for it.

Before the upload

The app checks the price against what you have already posted today and confirms your wallet can cover it. Nothing is charged, and nothing is uploaded until it passes.

The post publishes

Your post goes live exactly as it would inside the free allowance. Publishing never waits on a payment.

Then you pay

One transfer, one signature, for that post only. It settles on whichever of Base or BNB Chain holds enough DeHub tokens.

What counts against it

  • Text-only posts spend one of your daily text posts each.
  • Video, image and audio posts spend their file size against the data allowance — thumbnails included, since those are stored and served too.
  • Quote posts count exactly like the post they are: a quote with a video attached spends data.
  • Overage is pro-rata, not rounded up to a whole gigabyte. If 200 MB of an upload runs past your allowance, you pay for 200 MB.
  • Reposts, comments, reactions, tips and messages cost nothing and never touch the allowance.

If you decline

The post stays published. The unpaid amount stays open against your account and blocks your next paid post until it is settled — but never a free one. Whatever tomorrow's allowance gives you is always yours, whether or not anything is outstanding.

A badge moves both halves at once — a bigger free allowance and a lower price on anything past it. The discount is the same ladder badge holders already get when buying DeHub tokens, from 5% at Crab to 30% at Megalodon, so there is one answer to what a badge is worth. Your allowance comes from the badge you earned: a tier lent to you by a patron shows on your profile, but it does not hand you their posting allowance.

Tokenised Content & Fractionalised Ownership

Revolutionary ERC-1155 Content Tokenisation

Any upload or livestream on DeHub can be minted as an ERC-1155 NFT fractionalised into exactly 1,000 pieces. Minting is optional: a post publishes off-chain the moment you send it — no wallet, no signature, no gas — and you can mint it whenever you want from the post itself. Once minted, creators have complete control over how many fractions to sell or keep, creating a novel monetisation model where fans can invest in content they believe will succeed - essentially "betting" on the future of potential stars through a revolutionary form of fan tokens.

Automatic Fractionalisation

  • Any upload or stream can mint an ERC-1155 NFT
  • Automatically split into 1,000 fractions
  • Mint at publish, or any time afterwards
  • No additional setup required
  • Seamless blockchain integration

Creator Control

  • Choose how many fractions to sell
  • Retain control over distribution
  • Set custom pricing strategies
  • Decide release timing
  • Maintain creative ownership

Eternal Revenue

  • Content earns ad revenue for life
  • Permissionless residual income
  • Censorship-resistant earnings
  • No ongoing value creation required
  • Passive income for all eternity

Revolutionary Fan Investment Model

Betting on Future Stars

DeHub creates the first platform where fans can financially invest in creators they believe will become successful. By purchasing fractions of content NFTs, supporters become stakeholders in a creator's journey, earning returns when their chosen creators achieve success through ad revenue, tips, and other monetisation streams.

How Fractionalisation Works

1. Mint the Post

Choose to mint, and the post becomes an ERC-1155 NFT split into exactly 1,000 tradeable fractions. Skip it and the post still publishes — you can mint it later.

2. Creator Decision

Creators choose how many of their 1,000 fractions to sell, keep, or distribute to their community.

3. Fan Investment

Supporters purchase fractions, becoming stakeholders who earn proportional returns from all revenue streams.

Benefits for All Parties

For Creators

Instant monetisation, community funding, aligned incentives, and lifetime passive income from successful content.

For Fans

Financial upside from supporting rising stars, tradeable assets, and direct participation in creator success.

For Everyone

Censorship-resistant, permissionless system that creates value for all participants without platform dependency.

SocialFi Platform Comparison

The Key Difference: Residual vs. Active Value Creation

Unlike other SocialFi platforms where creators must continuously add value for their tokens, shares, or keys to maintain worth, DeHub content generates residual income for life. Once created, content earns ad revenue permanently - providing passive, permissionless, censorship-resistant income for all eternity without requiring ongoing creator effort.

DeHub Unique Advantages

  • Set and Forget: Content earns revenue forever without additional work
  • Fan Investment: Supporters financially benefit from creator success
  • One-Tap Tokenisation: Any upload can become a tradeable asset
  • Censorship Resistance: Sustained by shared computing power globally so you live forever onchain
  • Creator Control: Full control over token distribution strategy
  • Permissionless: No platform dependency for earnings

Revolutionary Use Cases

  • Early Talent Investment: Discover and invest in rising creators
  • Content Portfolio Building: Diversify across multiple creators
  • Creator Funding: Raise capital for productions through fraction sales
  • Fan Loyalty Rewards: Give fractions to top supporters
  • Viral Content Betting: Speculate on which content will succeed
  • Passive Income Streams: Earn from successful content forever

The Future of Content Economics

DeHub's ERC-1155 fractionalised content model represents the evolution from temporary creator-fan relationships to permanent economic partnerships. By letting creators mint any upload into 1,000 tradeable fractions, we're creating the first platform where content success directly and permanently benefits everyone involved - creators, fans, and investors - for all eternity, without requiring ongoing effort or platform dependency.

Customise and update your public profile or channel

Control what users can or can't see while being able to export your followers' data at any time. This gives you full ownership of your channel and allows you to take your business anywhere with you, no matter what happens.

  • Streamer level: Your own profile shows your streamer level, XP, streak and collectible cards, plus twenty themed streamer badges to unlock and choose from.
  • Badge showcase: Click a badge anywhere in the app to open it in the badge showcase, with the tier it belongs to and what it unlocks.
  • Total reach: Link your other socials and the profile adds your follower counts there to your DeHub followers, with the breakdown one tap away.
  • Playlists: Public bookmark folders appear on your profile as playlists that anyone can browse.
  • Find anything: Visitors can search, sort and filter a channel's posts by category, date, type and access, and see scheduled posts before they go live.
  • Your name as a link: A verified ENS name works as your profile address, alongside your DeHub username.

Top Up Tokens In 2 Clicks

Buying DeHub tokens directly inside the app.

We have our own in app currency, similar to Vbucks you get on Fortnite or TikTok coins, ours are called DeHub tokens. You will see these as gold coins across the app. They are used for premium services such as tips, subscriptions & more. Browsing is free, and so is posting inside the daily allowance every account gets — if you sign up with socials, email or SMS, we sponsor all gas fees for you. Wallet users pay standard ETH or BNB gas. Top up tokens in 2 clicks below.

Direct

DeHub Pay: buy with a card through Stripe, or with crypto from other chains, from $0.50

DeHub Token

Tokens are used for subscribing to creators, tipping streamers or unlocking content. The more you hold, the lower your fees are and the more superpowers you unlock like timeline trend boosts and verification badges.

Instant Payments

Using stripe, you can buy tokens instantly and seamlessly into whatever account you're logged into. DeHub makes tokens simple and for all. If you need more support, just pop up in our 24/7 live community chat and ask for admin support.

Secure Gateway

All payment details are encrypted and processed securely by Stripe, we can't access or store your sensitive information or card details giving you ultimate peace of mind.

Card, and not only DeHub tokens

The buy page runs on DeHub Pay. Pay by card, or pay with crypto you hold on another chain and it is converted for you. The minimum is $0.50. ETH and USDC can also be bought by card through MoonPay, on the chain you are already on, and land straight in the wallet the app signed you into. Once a purchase lands you can share it to the feed in one tap.

Important Notice

DeHub tokens serve as utility tokens within our ecosystem, similar to in-game currencies, and are not investment vehicles. While our blockchain infrastructure provides unprecedented transparency and verifiable on-chain data for educational purposes, all markets carry inherent risks. You could lose your entire investment due to market volatility, technical issues, security breaches, or unforeseen circumstances. Only participate with funds you can afford to lose completely. DeHub and its affiliates assume no responsibility for any financial losses incurred.

Explore The App & Beyond

Search bars aggregate YouTube and other major streaming app APIs to save you juggling multiple apps, while the explore page also houses our live community chat and dedicated leaderboards for:

  • Most views (MV)
  • Most subscribers (MS)
  • Biggest earners (BE)
  • Biggest spenders (BS)

That together will determine ad revenue share (RS). The exact algorithm to this is under beta and subject to change depending on revenue generated (RG)

This is the core algorithm, and experimentations in rewards will continue on a trial and error basis until the perfect equilibrium is found.

Flex Your Badge

Badge of Honour Model

The more DeHub tokens you hold, the more rewarding it is, simple as that. This includes but is not limited to the Badge of Honour system that unlocks improved cosmetics on your public profile as well as further enhanced, premium features.

The ladder is priced in dollars

The thirteen tiers, Crab through Megalodon, each cost a fixed amount in dollars rather than a fixed number of tokens. The number of DeHub tokens a tier asks for is that dollar cost at the live price, so a badge means the same commitment whatever the market is doing. Two protections come with it: the requirement never rises above the published numbers if the price falls, and once you have reached a tier you keep it — the badge you earned is locked to the cheapest requirement it was ever earned at, so a dip cannot strip it back off you.

What a badge unlocks

  • A lower fee on tips, pay-per-views, subscriptions and bounties, dropping 0.69% a tier.
  • A bigger free daily posting allowance, and a discount on anything past it.
  • The same discount when buying DeHub tokens, from 5% at Crab to 30% at Megalodon.
  • Superpowers, profile cosmetics, more profile slots, more images per post, and your own emoji, sticker and GIF packs.
  • More weight on what you do: a view or a reaction from a badge holder counts for more, on the same ladder as governance voting — one without a badge, two at Crab, and a rung more for every tier above it up to fourteen at Megalodon. It is a multiplier on your one reaction, never a second one.

Lend your badge

A badge can be lent. Every rung you have climbed gives you one delegation slot — one at Crab, thirteen at Megalodon — and each slot hands another account your own tier for as long as you leave it there. It exists because influence on DeHub is meant to travel with a group rather than sit on a single wallet: crews, teams and second accounts get the tier their backer holds, without anybody moving tokens or handing over keys.

  • Same tier, not one below: A Megalodon lends Megalodon. A badge claims the influence you command, so the people you back carry what you carry.
  • Slots come from your own stake: A borrowed badge carries no slots of its own, so a lent tier can never be lent onwards.
  • The patron is public: Hover a delegated badge anywhere in the app and it names who is backing it. Nothing is hidden about where a tier came from.
  • Reversible at any time: Take a slot back and the tier returns to you. Your own staking, fee tier and locked badge are untouched by anything you lend.
  • Status, not entitlements: A lent badge is what the platform shows, and it carries the weight that goes with the tier — a view or a reaction from it counts at the tier it was lent. What it does not carry is anything priced in money: your fee tier, your token purchase discount, your daily posting allowance and your own delegation slots are all still read from the stake you hold yourself.
  • Lend any rung you have climbed: A slot does not have to hand over your top tier. Pick the unlocked rung it lends, and back somebody at King Cobra without making them a Megalodon.
  • The other side has a say: A badge offered to an account shows up in their notification bell, and they can refuse it. Either of you can end a delegation afterwards.

Tip Your Favourites

Our Integrated tipping services across all uploads and live streams only come with a 10% fee, compared to the usual 60% charged by the likes of TikTok and other industry leaders while also having the ability to vote on video cancellations putting the power back into the viewer's hands.

Tips received for creators and tips given by viewers are logged in separate leaderboards along with viewer counts and subscribers that determine shares in ad revenue. Stakeholders of DeHub tokens receive their proportionate shares of overall protocol profit.

Tips work on posts, comments, direct messages and live streams. If you are short of DeHub tokens, the tip sheet offers your other balances — USDC, ETH or tokens on Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain or Arc — and converts them for you before the tip goes out. Once you have tipped a post, its tip button shows a sparkling diamond so you can see where you have already given.

Mine Through Content Moderation

Decentralised moderation mining and revenue share model

Only a few wallets hold over 50m DeHub tokens, of which most are operational wallets, with the remaining being known community members.

Only the core team or top tier badge holders will have the power to instantly remove a video by burning the NFT associated. Subsequently, all the ad revenue generated and any play to earn bounties strapped to the video will be shared with all voting wallets to further deter bad actors and incentivise an engaged community.

The amount of DeHub tokens required for all utility is a dynamic variable, so must be subject to be changed at any time in relation to price. Any changes will be announced publicly on all official channels.

Governance + Moderation System Design

Our comprehensive governance and moderation system creates a fair, transparent, and community-driven platform that prevents centralized censorship while maintaining quality standards through economic incentives and advanced mechanisms.

Token Utility Design

By default, DeHub tokens, our native governance token, enable the following roles:

  • Moderation staking
  • Voting on content disputes and platform rules
  • Curation and promotion of content

Key Principle: More tokens = more influence, but influence ≠ unchecked power.

Quadratic Voting

To reduce whale dominance:

  • We use quadratic voting for key moderation decisions.
  • Example: Voting power = √(tokens staked)
  • So, staking 100 tokens = 10 votes, 10,000 tokens = 100 votes (not 10,000 votes).

Moderation Staking Pools

  • Users can stake tokens to become moderators.
  • Each flagged piece of content enters a moderation queue.
  • Stakers vote on the outcome (ban, warn, ignore, etc).
  • Correct votes (as per final outcome) earn rewards; wrong votes may result in slashing.

Incentive: Stake = skin in the game. Higher-quality moderation = higher rewards.

Delegated Moderation (for scaling)

  • Users can delegate their votes to trusted curators or moderation pools (think: staking to a validator in PoS).
  • Curators/moderators can be swapped anytime.
  • This allows passive users to participate in governance while rewarding active ones.

Content Tiering via Curation Markets

  • Users stake tokens to "curate" or promote content.
  • The market decides what rises (token-weighted attention), not an algorithm.
  • If bad content is boosted and flagged, curators may be slashed.

DAO-Based Appeals

  • Content creators can appeal moderation decisions via DAO proposals.
  • Token holders vote (again with quadratic logic).
  • Helps prevent abuse by moderation cartels or brigading.

Progressive Access Control

Instead of "1 token = 1 power", implement progressive caps:

  • Your influence decays beyond certain staking thresholds.
  • Encourages wider distribution of token holdings.
  • Could use sigmoid functions or bonding curves.

Incentive Flywheel

  • Watchers earn token rewards for passive viewing (engagement mining).
  • Curators earn more if their promoted content performs well.
  • Moderators earn based on accuracy, rewarding good behaviour
  • Governance participants (voters on proposals) get small boosts for activity.

This creates a circular economy that drives participation & incentivises good beh

Anti-Manipulation Measures

  • Sybil resistance: Require staking + reputation for key votes.
  • Multi-signature council fallback: In case of DAO malfunction (only for emergencies).
  • Transparent moderation history: Every decision logged on-chain.

Voting on proposals

The design above is what governance is for; the Governance page is where it happens. Proposals are listed under Proposals, Passed and Rejected, each with its author, its text and where the vote stands. Opening a proposal costs a fee of 10,000 DeHub tokens, confirmed on chain, and each proposal has its own page with a threaded discussion. Voting is free: your vote is weighted by your badge, voting runs for seven days, and a proposal passes on a weighted majority with at least ten different wallets voting, so no single holder can pass something nobody saw.

Architecture

DAO Treasury

The DAO treasury at dehub.io/dao is one wallet anyone can send DeHub tokens to, read straight off the chain. The page shows its live balance on each chain, every contributor, and each contributor's share of the pool — and that share is the weight their vote carries when the DAO decides how the treasury is spent.

  • Contribute: Send DeHub tokens from your wallet with the Contribute button. Every token you add raises your share.
  • Power from contribution: Your power is what you have contributed divided by everything ever sent to the treasury. It is read from the chain and never expires.
  • Proposals: Contributors raise and vote on proposals for how the treasury is spent, directly from the treasury page.

Live Streaming

Platform Overview

Go live from the post composer, in your browser or from an encoder. Streams publish to DeHub's own ingest and play over WebRTC in near real time, with Livepeer as an automatic fallback when a network cannot reach the ingest. Every stream is permissionless and censorship resistant, has its own chat, and turns into a replay the moment it ends.

Key Features

  • Go live from the composer, with on-chain minting optional
  • Tiered gift animations, and tip messages read aloud on stream
  • Token-gated access for exclusive content
  • Pay-per-view and bounty reward systems
  • A chat for every stream, showing who joins and every gift
  • OBS, Streamlabs or any RTMP encoder, with a permanent stream key

Supported Tokens

Tips, gifts and unlocks settle in DeHub tokens, but you can pay from other balances — USDC, ETH or tokens on Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain or Arc — and they are converted for you.

Livestream Features

Stream Creation

  • Go live from the composer
  • Optional on-chain mint
  • Customizable settings
  • Multi-network support

Tipping System

  • Visual effects & tiers
  • Custom minimum amounts
  • Message attachments
  • Real-time rewards

Token Gating

  • Balance-based access
  • Exclusive content
  • Multi-token support
  • Instant verification

PPV & Bounties

  • One-time payments
  • Viewer rewards
  • First-come basis
  • Custom distributions

Streaming Methods

Web Streaming

Go live from your browser with your camera or by sharing your screen, with camera looks applied as you broadcast

External Streaming

Use OBS, Streamlabs or any RTMP encoder with the permanent stream key and server shown in Settings and on the Go Live sheet

Analytics & Metrics

  • Live Viewers
  • Tips Received
  • Stream Likes
  • Chat Activity

Technical Infrastructure

Ingest

DeHub's own ingest takes the stream from your browser or encoder, with Livepeer as an automatic fallback

Playback

Viewers watch over WebRTC in near real time, in the feed and on the post page, and a stream that ends becomes its replay without a reload

Chat & gifts

Each stream has its own chat room with joins and gifts shown in it, and the host runs the broadcast from a console showing viewers, likes and tips

Subscriptions

Revolutionary On-Chain Subscriptions

Creators sell subscriptions straight from their profile. Plans are priced in US dollars and paid in DeHub tokens at the live price, and the creator's share lands directly in their wallet, less DeHub's badge-tiered fee. Subscriber-only posts are a real gate: people who have not subscribed see a one-line teaser, not the post.

Creator Control

SuperPowers

SuperPowers turn a staking badge into reach you can spend. Every fortnight your badge grants boosts, and spending one puts a post in the slot at the top of the home feed. Team up is open to everyone and combines the wallet power of up to eight accounts, giving every member the badge their total unlocks. The slot rotates: when several boosts are running, viewers are dealt one weighted by badge tier, so a higher tier is shown more often and everybody still gets the window they were granted.

The twelve powers

Each rung of the badge ladder unlocks exactly one power, and every power you have unlocked stays unlocked. They all draw on the same fortnightly allowance, so the choice is what to spend it on.

  • Boost Put a recent post in the slot at the top of the home feed.
  • Second Wind Send a post older than a week back to the top of the feed.
  • Comment Anchor Hold the top of somebody else’s comment thread. Not the free pin an author already has on their own post — this one is yours, on their thread, and it expires.
  • Trend Jacker Put one of your categories on the trending list, where the whole platform is already looking.
  • Timeline Bomber Your followers see your post ahead of anybody else’s boost, so a King Cobra wins the draw against a Megalodon for the people who chose to hear from you.
  • Signal Flare One notification to your followers about one post. It spends a separate signal allowance, not your boosts.
  • Flak Jacket Your post cannot be downvote-buried while it runs — immunity from a pile-on, not from disagreement.
  • Precision Strike Reach the people who follow an account you name, whether or not they follow you.
  • Harpoon Notify every holder in the badge tiers you choose about one post. Also paid from the signal allowance.
  • Team up Combine wallet power with up to seven other accounts. Everyone in the team wears the badge the pooled balance unlocks, and it costs nothing. A team can be private, so people ask to join and the owner approves them.
  • Front Row Your live Stage takes the top of the stages rail while it runs, on every surface that lists Stages.
  • Deep Current Give one of your boosts to somebody else’s post. The top rung is the one that spends your reach on other people.

What each badge grants

Boosts per fortnight, and how long each one runs. Neither column ever goes down as you climb, and the total always goes up.

How the slot is shared

The slot rotates rather than pins. When several boosts are running at once, each viewer is dealt one, weighted by the booster’s badge tier — a higher tier is shown more often, and everybody still gets the window they paid for. What a boost buys is a share of voice for a set number of minutes, not sole possession of the top of the feed.

One clock for everybody

The cycle is a platform-wide fourteen days, so everyone’s allowance refills at the same moment. Nothing rolls over. Cancel a booking before it starts and the minutes go back into the cycle you paid them from.

What a boost cannot do

Every draw is re-checked against the post as it stands at that moment, so a post that has since been removed, blocked or marked mature never reaches a stranger’s feed. Mature posts are refused at booking too, and a boost is never dealt to somebody who has blocked you or the person you boosted.

  • Content preferences: Whether mature content appears for you, Kids Mode, default post visibility, autoplay and whether it starts muted, and a data-saver mode for metered connections.
  • Who can reach you: Direct message access and fees, whether others see when you are online, blocked accounts, blocked countries, Do Not Disturb and Quiet Hours that silence everything for a window you choose.
  • Notifications: Per-category switches for what is worth telling you about, browser notifications, and email notifications separately.
  • Your data: Export your chats, extract your data, review the devices and sessions signed into your account, choose whether AI systems may train on your work (allowed unless you switch it off), and delete your account.
  • Connected accounts & assets: Your multi-post accounts, a Solana wallet, your permanent stream key, biometric unlock, the usernames and fractions you own, and settings search that lands you on the exact setting.

  • Web: dehub.io in any modern browser, installable to your home screen or desktop.
